entities.summary: Antony John Williams is a British chemist and expert in the fields of both nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy and cheminformatics at the United States Environmental Protection Agency. He is the founder of the ChemSpider website that was purchased by the Royal Society of Chemistry in May 2009. He is a science blogger and an author. Antony John Williams was a scientists & inventors from St Asaph (b. 1964-06-05, St Asaph). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
